# Outcomes

The proposed engagement with PURE Financial Advisors LLC will drive measurable improvements in the quality, timeliness, and strategic value of pipeline and marketing reporting. By enabling accurate, automated Lead-to-AUM (L2A) and Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) analytics within Power BI, PURE’s leadership will gain actionable insights to optimize resource allocation and drive sustained growth. Success will be defined by enhanced data-driven decision-making, greater reporting scalability, and a clear understanding of marketing ROI.

## Expected Business Outcomes

- **Granular Pipeline Insights:** Empower leadership and stakeholders with detailed visibility into every phase of the customer journey from lead generation to assets under management, supporting more informed decision-making and improved pipeline performance.
- **Actionable Marketing ROI Measurement:** Deliver robust CAC reporting that enables the marketing team to directly assess the return on marketing spend, ensuring investments are effectively driving new client acquisition and firm growth.
- **Automated, Reliable Reporting:** Transition manual and fragmented reporting processes to automated data ingestion, transformation, and refresh cycles, resulting in timely, accurate, and repeatable business intelligence.
- **Integrated Data Ecosystem:** Seamlessly bring together data from Salesforce, QuickBooks, Tamarac, and Azure platforms, reducing silos and increasing confidence in analytics across the business.
- **Scalable Reporting Foundation:** Build a flexible reporting and data model architecture that supports future expansion—enabling PURE to incorporate additional data sources and analytic capabilities as business needs evolve.
- **Increased Data Maturity:** Enhance overall data quality and governance, positioning PURE as a data-driven organization with the ability to respond rapidly to strategic opportunities.

Key performance indicators will include improvements in lead-to-AUM conversion rates, reduced customer acquisition costs, and measurable increases in speed and accuracy of reporting. Success will be reflected in automated, trusted Power BI dashboards that consistently deliver the insights required for PURE’s continued growth and operational excellence.
